timing: Post-calibration audit, target outcomes and all fitting banks known. No target modification is permitted.
reason: Frozen fitted control mixtures sometimes use less than the candidate budget on checks. To avoid describing upper-budget compliance as exact resource equality, compute a separate optimistic exact-expected-budget reference over the FULL same-estimator control grids.
controls: All64 settings in each pooled_state, pooled_clock_age, bay_state_alpha50, bay_full_alpha0 arm, plus fixed60:257 policies in the union. Same source histories, actions and current model. Reuse existing check bank arrays where the exact policy is already available; replay every missing control on the same old BayIds and phases.
analysis: For every known check cell solve hindsight minimaxF/O at EXACT expected calls equal to the unchanged alpha500 headline. Show pooled128+fixed, Bay-state64+fixed, unshrunk64+fixed and union257+fixed reference sets separately. These are NOT frozen deployable comparisons, NOT bootstrap-confirmatory findings and do not use outcome selection to retune the target. Existing frozen controls and their confidence intervals remain the primary deployed-model comparisons.
limits: t>1 means at least one of the two control errors must exceed the target by the stated factor within that finite convex control family; it does not imply both errors are worse, universal optimality or world novelty. No new gamma/seed/penalty selection follows this diagnostic.
